{"id":1788847234,"question_id":3336,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"9 months, 3 weeks","timestamp":1759381196,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"0 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1788847234/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Water Bottles II","memory":"8.6 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int maxBottlesDrunk(int numBottles, int numExchange) {\n        int total_drunk = numBottles;\n        int emptied = numBottles;\n\n        while(emptied >= numExchange)\n        {\n            emptied = emptied - numExchange;\n            numExchange++;\n\n            //emptied bottle ke exchange me maine jo bottle li thi vo pi li\n            total_drunk++;\n            //usko peene ke baad vo wali bottle bhi khali ho gyi \n            emptied++;\n        }\n    return total_drunk;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"water-bottles-ii","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":861}
